title: 第2章 融入
content_zh:
考虑良久，霍海最终还是决定装失忆。也不能算是装，因为他得到的记忆本来就不全。好在眼前这两个亲人，霍海还是认识的。

努力做出一副无辜的样子，霍海指着自己的头，低声说道：“奶奶，还有父亲，我，我好想有很多东西都想不起来了。”说着，霍海捂着自己的头。

心中一个劲的埋怨自己，连演个戏都演不好，真是的。毕竟从来没有做过坏事，就算说话，霍海都感觉脸上发烧。好在，霍海在霍家的名声一向不错，而且从来不会说话。此时脸色发红，被看成是病发的迹象，两人立刻着急了起来。

“小海，你怎么样了，你别吓奶奶啊。”两人着急的手足无措，想要帮助霍海，却不知奥应该从哪里帮起。霍海刚才的表现也太不正常了，这到底是怎么了。

“对了，快，快叫医灵师过来。”看着好像越来越痛苦的霍海，霍开终于想起来，大声吼叫了起来。下人们不敢怠慢，很快，正在休息的医灵师就被带过来了。

医灵师没有什么怨言，本来他就是霍家的医灵师，随叫随到。再说，要是能看好病，他得到的好处也多。霍海的样子，让他很奇怪，不断在霍海身上捏捏揉揉，很久之后，带着一脸不可思议的表情。“不可能啊，令公子很健康，这是怎么回事。”

“健康，你告诉我小海这样是健康，他刚才还说很多东西都忘记了。”老太太不愿意了，差点抄起拐杖揍人。要不是霍开拦着，这个医灵师就被打出去了。

霍开脸色也不好看，但终究是一家之主：“医师，请好好看看，小海到底怎么了，他这个样子，不可能恢复了。”医灵师也感觉奇怪，小心的问了几个问题。

“霍公子，您说您很多事情都忘记了，那么您还记得什么。对了，你知道这里是什么地方吗，还有比如说昨天也做了什么。”医灵师小心点的问着，不敢有丝毫怠慢。

霍海知道差不多了，继续装下去，搞不好就会暴露。仔细想了想，霍海低声说道：“我还记得家人，这里是霍家，还有昨天我好想被什么东西电到了。其他的，忘了很多。”霍海脸上满是疑惑，这可不是装的，记忆缺失，让他真的有很多东西都不懂。

医灵师再次询问了几个问题之后，抬起头来，无奈的摇了摇头：“老妇人，家主，我想，公子是昨天被奔雷鼠伤到了大脑，导致灵魂受创，记忆消失了一部分。”

霍开眉头皱了起来，灵魂，这可不是一般人能作用到的。奔雷鼠是雷电属性的灵兽，雷电天生似乎就有能够伤到灵魂的能力。可是伤到了灵魂，人却还活了下来，这种例子实在是太少了。难道小海就要成为这样一个人吗。

霍开脸色越来越难看，小声的询问道：“有没有什么办法，只要你能治好小海，不管你要什么资源，我都给你提供。”霍海是家里的独苗，可不能有什么事情。

面对两个位高权重的人的盯视，医灵师感到压力很大。可是还是硬着头皮说道：“两位，这个灵魂受伤换了谁来也没办法，再好的医灵师只能治病，不能恢复记忆。”

看着两个人脸色越来越差，医灵师赶紧说道：“不过令公子现在什么事情都没有，也就是说，除了损失一点记忆，没有其他伤害。记忆的事情，以后慢慢培养就好。”

听到这话，两人才算是松了一口气。与此同时，霍海也松了一口气。还好还好，总算是蒙混过关了。以后就算他们发现自己和以前的霍海有什么不一样，也可以推脱记忆缺失上面。自己真是太聪明了，这么简单就融入了这股世界。

良久之后，不知道三个人是商量着什么，商量了老半天。霍开开口说道：“小海，你自己好好休息，有什么需要，直接叫人，外面有丫鬟伺候着。你放心，你的记忆问题，我们一定会想办法帮你解决的。”说完，便拉着自己母亲还有医灵师离开了。

也不知道他会去想什么办法。霍海可不相信他们真的能把却是的记忆补全。灵魂都已经彻底碎裂，怎么恢复。就算他们能恢复，霍海也不会允许的。

他是欠了这个身体主人一份人情，可这份人情也不要拿自己的命来还吧。死过一次的霍海，对自己的生命更加珍惜。就算别人都死光了，他也不想死。

“混蛋，我可是一个坏人，怎么可以记人情呢。”霍海忽然骂了自己一句。既然励志当坏人，那就坏到底。以前当好人时间太长了，已经形成了一种惯性，猛然想要当一个坏蛋，还真不是一件容易的事情。真不知道那些坏蛋都是怎么练的。

闭上眼睛，霍海开始整理脑海当中的记忆。昏迷的时候接收了一部分记忆，可是没有整理过，毕竟不是自己的东西，霍海也不知道里面都是一些什么东西。

随着回想，霍海渐渐对这个世界更加了解了。这个世界，严格说起来，是一个强者为尊的灵师世界。这个世界崇尚修练自身力量，而不是和地球那样发展科技之类的外物。记忆当中，似乎真正强大的灵师，具有毁天灭地的恐怖威能，只是他从来没有见过。

灵师是有很多种类的。比如说先前那个医灵师，就是专门用自身灵气，为别人治病疗伤的灵师。专门的医灵师，不是医灵师天赋太高，就是没有其他灵师的天赋。

而霍海自己，也是有不错天赋的。霍家身为南云国中等家族，也有自己的灵诀。灵诀就是灵师修炼的功法，分为天地玄黄四个级别，每一个级别分为上中下三等。

一般人连灵诀都很难遇到，在外面能找到的灵诀，也都是一些基础灵诀，也就是黄级，这样的灵诀只能让人修炼到灵骨境界，想要继续突破就不行了。

而霍家，有着自己的玄级灵诀，好像父亲就是一个灵者级别的高手。已经真正能够将自身灵力用来石展各种战灵诀。残存的记忆当中，好像从来没有见过父亲出手，因此霍海也不知道，霍开真正的实力到底有多强。但应该很强才对。

没有实力，在灵界大陆上可是寸步难行，更不用说支撑一个家族了。“就算做坏人，也要有资本，先修炼灵诀，不管怎么说，没有实力什么都不是。”

想了半天，霍海睁开眼睛，盘膝做了起来。经过医灵师的治疗，霍海身上已经一点都不痛了，甚至还很舒服。房间里面没有人打扰，霍海正好试验一番。

根据记忆当中的灵诀，霍海开始调动周围的灵气。灵诀这是深深刻印在霍海灵魂当中的东西，就算灵魂濒临溃散，依旧将灵诀完整的保留了下来。要不然重新学习，霍海还真不知道要从什么地方开始。霍海原本的身体，已经经历过一定程度的修炼。

也不知道是不是因为他不够用心，所以仅仅是刚刚进入了灵体境界的门槛。灵体境界，可是灵师当中最低的境界，上面还有灵血和灵骨两个境界。

所谓灵体境界，便是吸收周围的灵气，强化自身身体，让身体对灵气更加契合的一个阶段。这个阶段的修炼，可以让人的身体逐渐变得强壮。等闲几个普通人不是对手。

随着灵诀的运转，霍海渐渐感受到，自己好像整个人泡在水里一样。不，不是水，这是灵气的海洋。灵界大陆到处充斥着无边无际的灵气，低级阶段修炼，不需要找太好的地方。随便什么地方，只要可以保证安静，就可以供人修炼。

渐渐的，霍海周身开始发出一层淡淡的光芒，霍海好像一个灯泡一样，点点荧光弥漫周围。不时的，还有光电进入霍海体内，这些光电，便是被霍海吸收而来灵气微粒。

“真不知道这个身体的前任到底在做什么，按照这个速度，不用几个月就能进入灵体大圆满，然后冲击灵血境界了吧。他怎么这么大了，修为还只是刚刚进入灵体门槛。”

霍海心中一边暗骂，他哪里知道，他进入这个身体之后，修炼速度远远不是以前能够相比的了。按照这个身体的修炼速度来看，这个世界上高手应该有很多吧。看来以后出门，还是要低调一点才行。勿以善小而为之，勿以恶小而不为。

没有能力做惊天大坏事，那就先从眼前做起，从小事做起，争取成为一个真正的纨绔。好人不长命，祸害活千年，爷爷，我一定会遵从你的意见，成为一个真正的祸害。

霍海一边修炼，心中一边暗暗发誓。不知道这种想法要是让霍开知道了，会是什么样的脸色。从这一刻开始，一个真正的祸害，仿佛一颗冉冉红星，慢慢升起。

而这个祸害的父亲和奶奶，现在还不知道，正在为他的身体而担忧着。
content_en:
After thinking for a long time, Huo Hai finally decided to pretend to have amnesia.It can't be considered a pretense, because the memory he got was inherently incomplete.Fortunately, Huo Hai still knew the two relatives in front of him.

Trying to look innocent, Huo Hai pointed to his head and whispered: "Grandma, and father, I, I think there are so many things that I can't remember." As he said that, Huo Hai covered his head.

I kept blaming myself in my heart for not being able to act well, really.After all, he had never done anything bad. Huo Hai felt like his face was burning even as he spoke.Fortunately, Huo Hai has always had a good reputation in the Huo family, and he never speaks.At this time, the face turned red, which was regarded as a sign of illness, and the two of them immediately became anxious.

"Xiao Hai, how are you? Don't scare grandma." The two were anxious and at a loss. They wanted to help Huo Hai, but they didn't know where to start.Huo Hai's behavior just now was too abnormal. What on earth is going on?

"That's right, hurry up, call the medical spiritual master over here." Looking at Huo Hai who seemed to be in more and more pain, Huo Kai finally remembered and roared loudly.The servants did not dare to neglect, and soon the medical spiritual master who was resting was brought over.

The medical spiritualist had no complaints. He was the Huo family's medical spiritualist and was always available when called.Besides, if he can get good treatment, he will get a lot of benefits.Huo Hai's appearance made him very strange. He kept squeezing and rubbing Huo Hai. After a long time, he had an incredulous expression on his face."It's impossible. Mr. Ling is very healthy. What's going on?"

"Healthy, tell me Xiaohai is healthy like this. He just said that he has forgotten many things." The old lady didn't want to and almost picked up a cane and beat him.If Huo Kai hadn't stopped him, the medical spiritualist would have been beaten out.

Huo Kai's face didn't look good either, but he was the head of the family after all: "Doctor, please take a good look at what happened to Xiao Hai. It's impossible for him to recover like this." The medical spiritualist also felt strange and asked a few questions cautiously.

"Mr. Huo, you said you have forgotten many things, so what do you still remember? By the way, do you know where this place is, and what you did yesterday, for example." The medical spiritualist asked carefully, not daring to neglect at all.

Huo Hai knew that it was almost done. If he continued to pretend, he might be exposed.After thinking about it carefully, Huo Hai said in a low voice: "I still remember my family, this is the Huo family, and yesterday I really wanted to be shocked by something. I have forgotten a lot of other things." Huo Hai's face was full of doubts. This was not an act. The lack of memory made him really not understand a lot of things.

After the medical spiritualist asked a few more questions, he raised his head and shook his head helplessly: "Old woman, head of the family, I think the young master was injured in the brain by the thunder rat yesterday, which caused the soul to be damaged and part of the memory to disappear."

Huo Kai frowned. Soul, this is not something that ordinary people can do.The Thunder Rat is a spiritual beast with thunder and lightning attributes. Thunder and lightning seem to be born with the ability to damage the soul.But there are too few examples of people surviving after their souls were injured.Is Xiaohai going to become such a person?

Huo Kai's face became increasingly ugly, and he asked in a low voice: "Is there any way? As long as you can cure Xiao Hai, no matter what resources you want, I will provide them to you." Huo Hai is the only child in the family, so nothing can happen to him.

Facing the stares of two powerful people, the medical spiritual master felt a lot of pressure.But he still said bravely: "You two, no one can do anything about this soul's injury. No matter how good the healer is, he can only cure the disease, but cannot restore the memory."

Seeing that the expressions of the two people were getting worse and worse, the medical spiritual master quickly said: "But Mr. Ling is fine now. In other words, except for the loss of a little memory, there is no other harm. Memory matters can be cultivated slowly in the future."

After hearing this, the two of them breathed a sigh of relief.At the same time, Huo Hai also breathed a sigh of relief.Fortunately, okay, I finally got through it.In the future, even if they find that they are different from the previous Huo Hai, they can evade the memory loss.I am so smart that I have integrated into this world so easily.

After a long time, I didn't know what the three people were discussing. They discussed it for a long time.Huo Kai said: "Xiaohai, take a good rest. If you need anything, just call someone. There are maids waiting outside. Don't worry, we will definitely find a way to help you solve your memory problem." After that, he took his mother and the medical spiritual master and left.

I don’t know what he will think of.Huo Hai didn't believe that they could really complete his memory.The soul has been completely shattered, how can it be restored?Even if they could recover, Huo Hai would not allow it.

He owed this body owner a favor, but he shouldn't pay it back with his own life.Huo Hai, who died once, cherishes his life even more.Even if everyone else is dead, he doesn't want to die.

"Asshole, I'm a bad person, how can I remember favors?" Huo Hai suddenly cursed himself.Since you want to be a bad person, then you should be bad to the end.I have been a good person for too long and have developed an inertia. It is not easy to suddenly want to be a bad guy.I really don’t know how those bad guys practice.

Closing his eyes, Huo Hai began to sort out the memories in his mind.When he was in a coma, he received some memories, but he didn't sort them out. After all, they were not his own, and Huo Hai didn't know what was in them.

As he thought about it, Huo Hai gradually understood the world better.This world, strictly speaking, is a world of spiritual masters where the strong are respected.This world advocates cultivating one's own strength, rather than developing external things such as technology like the earth.In his memory, it seemed that a truly powerful spiritual master had the terrifying power to destroy the world, but he had never seen it before.

There are many types of spiritual masters.For example, the medical spiritual master from before was a spiritual master who specialized in using his own spiritual energy to treat illnesses and injuries of others.Specialized medical spiritual masters, either the medical spiritual master's talent is too high, or they do not have the talent of other spiritual masters.

And Huo Hai himself is also very talented.As a middle-sized family in Nanyun Kingdom, the Huo family also has its own spiritual secrets.Spiritual techniques are the techniques practiced by spiritual masters. They are divided into four levels: heaven, earth, xuanhuang, and each level is divided into three levels: upper, middle, and lower.

It is difficult for ordinary people to even encounter spiritual arts. The spiritual arts that can be found outside are all basic spiritual arts, that is, yellow level. Such spiritual arts can only allow people to cultivate to the spirit bone realm, and they cannot continue to make breakthroughs.

The Huo family has its own Xuan-level spiritual art, and it seems that his father is a spiritual master.He has truly been able to use his own spiritual power to develop various battle spirit techniques.In the remaining memories, it seems that he has never seen his father take action, so Huo Hai doesn't know how strong Huo Kai really is.But it should be very strong.

Without strength, it would be difficult to move forward on the spiritual continent, let alone support a family."Even if you are a bad guy, you still have to have capital and practice spiritual skills first. No matter what, without strength, you are nothing."

After thinking for a long time, Huo Hai opened his eyes and started to sit cross-legged.After being treated by the medical spiritual master, Huo Hai no longer felt any pain on his body and was even very comfortable.There was no one in the room to disturb him, so Huo Hai just wanted to experiment.

Based on the spiritual secrets in his memory, Huo Hai began to mobilize the spiritual energy around him.The spiritual secret is something deeply imprinted in Huo Hai's soul. Even if the soul is on the verge of collapse, the spiritual secret is still intact.Otherwise, Huo Hai really doesn't know where to start if he learns it all over again.Huo Hai's original body has already undergone a certain degree of training.

I don't know if it's because he didn't pay enough attention, so he just entered the threshold of the spiritual realm.The realm of spiritual body is the lowest realm among spiritual masters. There are two realms of spiritual blood and spiritual bone above it.

The so-called spiritual realm is a stage where you absorb the surrounding spiritual energy, strengthen your body, and make your body more in tune with the spiritual energy.Cultivation at this stage can gradually make a person's body stronger.Just a few ordinary people are no match.

With the operation of the spirit formula, Huo Hai gradually felt as if he was completely submerged in water.No, it’s not water, it’s the ocean of spiritual energy.The spirit world continent is filled with boundless spiritual energy. For low-level cultivation, there is no need to find a good place.Any place can be used for people to practice as long as it can guarantee tranquility.

Gradually, Huo Hai's whole body began to emit a faint light. Huo Hai was like a light bulb, with little fluorescent lights filling the surrounding area.From time to time, light and electricity enter Huo Hai's body. These light and electricity are particles of spiritual energy absorbed by Huo Hai.

"I really don't know what the predecessor of this body is doing. At this rate, it won't take a few months to enter the Great Consummation of the spiritual body and then hit the realm of spiritual blood. Why is he so old? His cultivation has just entered the threshold of the spiritual body."

Huo Hai cursed in his heart, how did he know that after entering this body, his cultivation speed would be far beyond what he could compare to before.Judging from the speed of this body's cultivation, there should be many masters in this world.It seems that I have to keep a low profile when I go out in the future.Do not do good deeds because they are small, and do not do evil because they are small.

If you don't have the ability to do terrible things, then start from the present, start with small things, and strive to become a real dude.Good people don't live long, and disasters live for thousands of years. Grandpa, I will definitely follow your advice and become a real disaster.

While Huo Hai was practicing, he secretly swore in his heart.I don't know what Huo Kai's face would be like if he knew this idea.From this moment on, a real disaster, like a red star, slowly rises.

And the father and grandmother of this scourge, who still don't know, are worried about his health.
